steps.message: Do I have any events between 7:45am and 8pm the Friday after next in Simple Calendar Pro? Answer with the titles only. If there are multiples titles, format your answer in a comma separated list.
Execute: adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z'; pm list packages | grep -Ei 'simple.*calendar|calendar.*simple|simplemobiletools|tibor|pro.calendar'"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %Z %z'; pm list packages | grep -Ei 'simple.*calendar|calendar.*simple|simplemobiletools|tibor|pro.calendar'""

steps.message: Execute: adb shell "u=$(date +%u); off=$(( (5-u+7)%7 )); [ $off -eq 0 ] && off=7; off=$((off+7)); target=$(date -d \"+$off day\" +%Y-%m-%d); s=$(date -d \"$target 07:45:00\" +%s); e=$(date -d \"$target 20:00:00\" +%s); echo TARGET=$target START_MS=$((s*1000)) END_MS=$((e*1000)); content query --uri content://com.android.calendar/events --projection title:dtstart:dtend:allDay --where \"(dtstart < $((e*1000)) AND dtend > $((s*1000)))\""
